cases.title: Full operation body
cases.given: same transition key with changed pin_id, purpose, root content or metadata
cases.then: reject conflict before IO and preserve original receipt

cases.title: Unknown body field
cases.given: an otherwise valid closed role request with an unknown property
cases.then: reject InvalidRequest before hash or IO

cases.title: Resolvable schema root
cases.given: one designated schema file and its local definitions
cases.then: every reference resolves within that file

cases.title: Large wire integer
cases.then: preserve exact decimal digits without Number conversion

cases.title: Unknown mutation outcome
cases.then: report UnverifiedOutcome without automatic retry or inferred success

cases.title: Committed retention failure
cases.given: one verified content commit and failed root transfer
cases.then: report AppliedRetentionDeferred and retain actual revision and Held pin

cases.title: Revoked binding
cases.given: an old binding after writer transfer or restart
cases.then: reject binding authority before replay disclosure
